scope: Five synthetic packaging-helper regressions; the final APK and source archive have not been packaged by this test.
checks: Incremental hashing and exact byte comparisons reject unbounded source reads and detect differences across chunk boundaries.
The generated ZIP passes CRC; SHA256SUMS covers every exact relative archive path. Hidden files, node_modules, classes and Python caches remain excluded.
Private signing test material remains included with 0600 permissions; normal source entries retain 0644 permissions and deterministic timestamps.
An 8 MiB incompressible file packages with under 4 MiB measured peak Python heap while Path.read_bytes is disabled.
Source mutation or CRC failure removes the temporary ZIP and preserves the previous published file.
Atomic APK copying verifies its expected SHA256 before replacement, preserves the previous output on mismatch and cleans staging.
The required current-release receipt list includes separator-verification.json and build-integrity-verification.json; both must explicitly pass and declare the matching release.
QA .log files are included only beneath qa/release-1.6.0; historical logs, hidden paths, fixtures, generated files, node_modules and compiled classes remain excluded.
